biggest_catch: Only available to existing Ameriprise Financial investment clients - this is a relationship bonus, not open to the general public. The $1,000 top tier requires parking $100,000+ for 90 days after a 30-day deposit window. Window ends 2026-12-29.
catches: Only available to existing Ameriprise Financial investment clients and employees of Ameriprise Financial, Inc. and its affiliates.
Open a new Ameriprise Bank Savings Account between July 1, 2026 and December 29, 2026.
Make one or more eligible deposits within 30 calendar days of opening that total one of the qualifying tiers: $25,000-$49,999.99 for $350; $50,000-$99,999.99 for $650; $100,000 or more for $1,000.
Eligible deposits are from external accounts outside of Ameriprise Bank, FSB and its affiliates (including eligible Ameriprise brokerage credits within seven business days of crediting/settlement).

Maintain the daily balance for the assigned bonus tier for 90 calendar days from the end of the deposit period; if the daily balance drops below the tier minimum, the client may qualify for a lower tier based on the lowest daily balance, provided it does not drop below $25,000; balances above the assigned tier do not qualify for a higher tier.
Account must be open and in good standing when the bonus is credited.
Limit one savings bonus per Group ID; clients who previously received any Ameriprise Bank Savings Account bonus are not eligible.
Bonus credited to the new Savings Account within 14 business days after the maintenance period; reported as interest on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Companion checking bonus: $400 for $1,500+ qualifying DDs in 90 days (taken as R0951).

steps: Open a new Ameriprise Bank Savings Account between July 1, 2026 and December 29, 2026 (must already be an Ameriprise Financial investment client).
Make eligible deposits totaling $25,000+ ($350 tier), $50,000+ ($650 tier), or $100,000+ ($1,000 tier) within 30 calendar days of opening.
Maintain the tier's daily balance for 90 calendar days from the end of the deposit period.
The bonus is credited to the new Savings Account within 14 business days after the maintenance period.
